english.title: Sell / supply / possess for sale / supply a medicinal product packaged in breach of Pt 13 Human Medicines Regs 2012
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) AT **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person to whom regulation 269 of Human Medicines Regulations 2012 applied,

(A)_[sold or supplied]_
(B)_[offered to sell or supply]_
(C)_[possessed for the purposes of sale or supply]_

a medicinal product, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT..), knowing or having reasonable cause to believe that

(D)_[a package or package leaflet relating to the medicinal product did not comply with the applicable requirements of Part 13 of those regulations in that **(..SPECIFY NON-COMPLIANCE..)]_
(E)_[a package or package leaflet relating to the medicinal product did not comply with the applicable requirements of regulation 50C(4) of those regulations in that **(..SPECIFY NON-COMPLIANCE..)]_
(F)_[a package or package leaflet relating to the medicinal product did not comply with the applicable requirements of regulation 50D(8) of those regulations in that **(..SPECIFY NON-COMPLIANCE..)]_
(G)_[a package or package leaflet relating to the medicinal product did not comply with the applicable requirements of regulation 58A(2)(b) of those regulations in that **(..SPECIFY NON-COMPLIANCE..)]_
(H)_[the product was not accompanied by a package leaflet when one was required by virtue of Part 13 of those regulations]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 269(2) and 271 of the Human Medicines Regulations 2012.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
in the course of a business
sold / supplied OR
possessed for the purposes of sale / supply
a medicinal product
with packaging which was prohibited
under regulation 269 Human Medicines Regulations 2012

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
